items.what: WAN을 통한 지리적으로 분산된 인프라에서 SLO 기반 LLM 서빙 아키텍처 제시, prefill/decode disaggregation과 파이프라인 병렬화 평가
items.relation: prefill/decode 분리와 파이프라인 병렬화를 다루어 H1의 통신 최적화와 맞닿아 있으나, WAN 환경의 극단적 latency와 GPU 포함 가능성이 1GbE CPU-only 전제와 크게 다름
items.gap: WAN의 신뢰성 낮은 cross-site hop vs. 1GbE 근거리; GPU 메모리 계층 vs. CPU 메모리만; 통신 버블의 성격이 H1의 가정(barrier straggler)과 다를 수 있음
hypothesis_notes: H1: prefill 시간의 25~45 %가 통신+barrier 대기이며, 그중 대기(straggler) 가 순수 전송보다 크다
items.title: InferSlice: A Reference Architecture for SLO-driven LLM Inference over a Telco Wide-Area Network
items.abstract: LLM inference is increasingly deployed as a core service for enterprise and interactive applications, but sovereignty, compliance, latency and resource-locality requirements can limit the suitability of centralised cloud deployments. Telco operators offer geographically distributed compute and network infrastructure for addressing these constraints. However, existing LLM serving frameworks are designed for tightly coupled data centres and provide limited support for coordinating geographically distributed and heterogeneous resources. We present InferSlice, a reference architecture for Service-

items.what: 장문 컨텍스트에서 KV 캐시 재사용 시 다층 저장소(GPU/호스트/NVMe)의 적응형 I/O 스케줄링으로 TTFT 개선
items.relation: KV 캐시 최적화는 H3(KV 연산 감소)와 같은 축이나, 저장소 I/O 병목 해결 vs. 연산 FLOPs 감소로 최적화 방향이 다름
items.gap: 전제: long-context(prefix reuse) vs. 사용자는 0.5~4K 단문; GPU/호스트 메모리 다층 계층 vs. CPU-only 단층; 매번 새 프롬프트 처리 vs. prefix 재사용 워크로드
hypothesis_notes: H3: 상위 절반 레이어의 KV를 xk에서 직접 산출하면 prefill FLOPs가 ~48 % 감소
items.title: KVStream: Adaptive Parallel Storage Management for KV Caching in Large-Scale LLM Serving
items.abstract: Long-context LLM serving for agentic, coding, and document workloads reuses prefixes whose key-value (KV) cache outgrows GPU and host memory, putting storage I/O on the critical path of the inference step for retrieving prefixes. A single node-local NVMe absorbs all retrievals, while the parallel file system or cloud file store that nodes already mount carries almost no inference traffic. We cast prefix retrieval as aggregate-bandwidth scheduling across these tiers and present KVStream, a KV cache engine that batches a step's reads, defers writes behind the forward pass, replicates each chunk

items.what: LLM activation 벡터의 신경피드백 기반 제어 능력을 측정하여 모델의 자신의 활성화에 대한 접근성 평가
items.relation: inference 파이프라인 최적화, 통신, 병렬화, 연산 효율 등과 무관한 주제(activation probing과 interpretability)
items.title: Cross-Model In-Context Neurofeedback Reveals (Limited) Activation Control in LLMs
items.abstract: Probes on activation vectors are widely used to detect misbehavior in language models, but their success relies on the assumption that models cannot control what their activations encode. Humans can learn, through neurofeedback, to control the firing of even single neurons, and recent studies investigated whether this ability extends to language models, reaching conflicting conclusions. No experimental design so far disentangles competence at the task from genuine access to one's own activations.
